directive: Only one player deity may be active on the battlefield at a time. Existing party assumptions must be audited before production rewrites.
coreDecision: Mythos Gates: Ascension becomes a Solo Deity Tactical RPG: one legendary player deity versus battlefield-scale enemy problems.

requiresModification.change: Replace party roles with solo combat archetype blends, unique mechanics, sustain, reactions, stances, Divinity, and executions.
Change teamSize from 3/5 assumptions to one active deity; redesign missions by tactical purpose.
Stop treating missions as multi-deity objective pressure tests; assign mission types, solo hazards, boss phases, and deity suitability tags.
Replace DeityPower recommendations with activeDeityPower, mastery, stance unlocks, relic builds, and solo readiness.
Replace saved defense Deities with one defensive deity build, equipment, AI behavior profile, and battlefield choice.
Top enemy/objective state, center battlefield, bottom deity controls for abilities, movement, stance, Momentum, Divinity, reactions.
Enemies must surround, deny Momentum, interrupt, protect objectives, and exploit one powerful target.

requiresReplacement.replacement: Flexible archetype blends: Juggernaut, Duelist, Shadow, Destroyer, Dominion, Warden, Reaver, Arcanist, Trickster.
Solo sustain verbs: regeneration, lifesteal, shields, parry, dodge, execution recovery, debuffs, terrain denial.
divine mastery, terrain affinity, relic loadout, stance discipline, and mission counter-pick logic.
Asynchronous deity Challenge defensive deity snapshot.

shouldBeRemoved: Any normal battle rule requiring multiple allied deities on the field.
Adjacent-allied objective protection bonuses in standard combat.
Role restrictions that require a healer/support slot.
Mission copy implying a chosen deity of several player Deities unless explicitly future reserve/story exception.
shouldBeDeferred: Reserve deity swapping: architect fields only; do not implement normal battlefield reserves yet.
True live PvP: keep async deity Challenge first.
Full procedural encounter generation: define hooks after handcrafted solo mission types are validated.
Production rewrite of all 280 mission payloads: begin after solo data model and engine primitives land.
dependencies: Solo combat state schema before UI controls.
Momentum and Divinity reducers before Ascendant stance and Divine Ascension.
Reaction resolver before advanced enemy AI timing.
Execution vulnerability thresholds before enemy health tuning.
Destructible terrain schema before Destroyer mastery and environmental battle missions.
Boss phase model before campaign finale redesign.

risks.risk: One Deity may feel invincible or helpless.
risks.mitigation: Use Momentum, reactions, terrain, sustain windows, and enemy coordination instead of raw HP inflation.
Every deity receives a unique mechanic and mission-counterplay profile.
Bottom action rail with stance/resource/reaction clarity; progressive disclosure for enemy details.
Rewrite mission templates and lore justification before production campaign conversion.

risks.risk: Async arena can masquerade as real PvP.
risks.mitigation: Label it only as Asynchronous deity Challenge.

Reaction prompt overlay during enemy action windows.
Enemy intent markers built for surrounding/flanking threats.
Terrain tooltip and destructible object affordances.
Boss phase banner and Divine Ascension cinematic trigger.

implementationOrder: 1. Lock solo design doctrine and roster redesign.
2. Update schemas and validators for solo fields.
3. Add engine reducers for Momentum, Divinity, stance, reaction, execution.
